title: Kissed Velvety Brazilian Chicken Stew
description: A rich and velvety one-pot Brazilian dish featuring onion and poach, made in a cataplana vessel with ayurvedic-rajasic-friendly ingredients.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a cataplana vessel over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent and starting to caramelize.
Add the diced poach and cook for an additional 5 minutes.
Add the chicken breast and cook until it is browned on all sides.
Add the coconut milk, dried thyme, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer, then reduce the heat to low and cook, covered, for 25 minutes.
Remove the cataplana from the heat and let it cool slightly.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
